title: Self-adaptive variable-stiffness flexible tail handle based on non-Newtonian fluid and robotic fish with self-adaptive variable-stiffness flexible tail handle
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater bionic robots, and particularly relates to a self-adaptive variable-rigidity flexible tail handle based on non-Newtonian fluid and a robotic fish with the structure. According to the self-adaptive variable-rigidity flexible tail handle, the rigidity can be automatically adjusted according to the swing frequency of the body of the robotic fish, so that the tail handle completes self-adaptive rigidity adjustment on the driving frequency, that is, the higher the frequency is, the harder the tail handle is, and the adaptive capacity of the bionic robotic fish in different scenes can be further improved. The invention further provides a robotic fish with the self-adaptive variable-rigidity flexible tail handle based on the non-Newtonian fluid, a flexible joint is adopted for the fish tail, a four-cylinder plunger pump is adopted for providing pressure, a pressure regulating valve and an electromagnetic reversing valve are omitted, the fish tail is of a rigid-flexible coupling structure, the two ends of a driving unit are fixed to a connecting body, and the driving unit is connected with the connecting body. An oil conveying pipe and a flexible sensor are further arranged in the fishtail, pectoral fins can rotate, a hydraulic loop is internal circulation, the requirement for cost reduction is met, and underwater swing can be smoother.

title: Vector propulsion bionic robot capable of actively adjusting posture
abstract: The invention discloses a vector propulsion bionic robot capable of actively adjusting the posture, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots. The vector propulsion bionic robot comprises an umbrella-shaped body module, a tentacle module and a posture adjusting module; the umbrella-shaped body module comprises an umbrella-shaped head part and a skirt-shaped tail part, and the skirt-shaped tail part is formed by a high-elasticity film; the tentacle module comprises swing arms circumferentially installed on the periphery of the umbrella-shaped head, the swing arms can swing in a multi-stage mode towards or away from the axis of the umbrella-shaped head, and the swing arms are sequentially and fixedly connected with the skirt-shaped tail from the head end to the tail end along the axis of the skirt-shaped tail. The posture adjusting module comprises a rotating mechanism and a pendulum bob capable of swinging, and the pendulum bob is eccentrically and rotationally connected to the center of the umbrella top end of the umbrella-shaped head through the rotating mechanism. The rotating mechanism drives the pendulum bob to eccentrically rotate to achieve direction adjustment, the pendulum bob swings to achieve pitching angle adjustment, the swing arm and the skirt-shaped tail are matched to achieve autonomous three-dimensional space swimming posture change, various basic motions are completed in the mode that the goodness of fit with jellyfish motions in real life is high, and the bionic degree is high.

title: Parallel type underwater vectored thruster
abstract: A parallel type underwater vectored thruster mainly comprises a machine frame, a turning machine and three movement branch chains for connecting the machine frame with the turning machine. Each movement branch chain is composed of a lower connection rod, a middle connection rod and an upper connection rod, wherein the lower connection rod and the machine frame are connected through a rotary pair or a sphere pair; the lower connection rod and the middle connection rod are connected through a rotary pair or a sphere pair; the middle connection rod and the upper connection rod are connected through a rotary pair; and the upper connection rod and the turning machine are connected through a rotary pair or a sphere pair. The three movement branch chains are connected with one another through three coupling connection rods and one center connection rod, one end of each coupling connection rod is fixedly connected with the middle connection rod of the corresponding movement branch chain, and the other end of each coupling connection rod is connected with the center connection rod through a rotary pair. Two-freedom-degree rotation of the turning machine relative to the machine frame can be achieved, the parallel type underwater vectored thruster has the advantages of being small in size, large in rigidity, high in precision, large in rotary working space and the like, and the parallel type underwater vectored thruster can be widely applied to ship thrust systems.

title: Multi-device integrated navigation system and method of underwater robot
abstract: The invention, which belongs to marine equipment, provides a multi-device integrated navigation system and method of an underwater robot. The system comprises a strapdown inertial navigation device, aglobal satellite positioning system, a Doppler log, a depth meter, an ocean current meter, a propulsion motor and an electronic chart. The Doppler log obtains absolute speed information and off-bottom height information of the water bottom by an underwater robot in real time after the underwater robot is arranged in water; the depth meter outputs navigation depth information of the underwater robot in real time; the ocean current meter outputs an ocean current speed and direction in real time; the propulsion motor outputs the rotation speed of the propulsion motor in real time; and the strapdown inertial navigation device receives related information outputted by the global satellite positioning system, the Doppler log, the depth meter, the ocean current meter and the propulsion motor, reads map information of the electronic chart through an integrated navigation fusion algorithm, and outputs position information, attitude information and speed information of the underwater robot in real time to form accurate navigation and positioning information of the underwater robot.

title: AUV three-dimensional airway planning method
abstract: The invention discloses an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) three-dimensional airway planning method, which improves the planning speed and planning speed of an algorithm by improving a particle initialization method, setting a punishment value for entering an obstacle and setting the step length of an added particle moving position. The method mainly comprises the steps of three-dimensional environment abstract modeling, particle position initialization, punishment value setting of entering obstacles, cost function value calculation, particle movement step length setting, cost value comparison of a particle swarm, particle position updating and planning result output. Compared with a traditional quantum particle swarm airway planning algorithm, the three-dimensional airway planning method provided by the invention considers the influence of ocean current factors, so that the algorithm application is wider; meanwhile, compared with two-dimensional air route planning, three-dimensional air route planning is more practical, and the actual navigation requirement can be better met.

title: SOUND CODE TAG-BASED CONFIGURATION METHOD, DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: Embodiments of the invention disclose a configuration method and device based on an acoustic code tag. The method includes the steps of converting predetermined configuration information into an acoustic code tag in a preset frequency band; and sending, in the preset frequency band, the acoustic code tag to a receiving end device.

title: The battery charging device for Vehicles
abstract: When taking off and landing, the conventional drone takes off and lands vertically in a take-off and landing manner, and when reaching a certain altitude, a wing portion to which a solar cell plate is attached is formed in a foldable manner, so that the solar cell plate is unfolded using a servomotor as a driving means, electricity is supplied to the motor while charging a secondary battery by the solar cell and supplying electricity to the motor to rotate the propeller to fly. The propeller of the drone rotates 90 degrees using the servomotor as the driving means in the conventional propeller to be a forward type, or a propeller in which the motor and the propeller are integrated is formed on one side of the solar cell plate, and the foldable plate on which the solar cell plate is formed has a cross section convex upward so that lift is generated according to Bernoulli's law.

title: Unmanned ship
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned ship. The unmanned ship comprises a ship body and a main propeller, and the main propeller is arranged at the tail part of the ship body; and the unmanned ship further comprises lateral propellers, the lateral propellers are arranged at the head part of the ship body, and the lateral propellers are used for generating propelling force in an angle with the lengthdirection of the ship body. According to the unmanned ship, the main propeller at the tail part of the ship body is used for generating propelling force, so that the movement is realized; when the extremely small turning radius movement is needed to be realized, the lateral propellers are used for generating the lateral propelling force to be matched with the main propeller, so that the free adjustment of the posture in an extremely small range in a dynamic state can be realized; and therefore, the unmanned ship can be matched with an underwater robot more flexibly, and the cooperative work ofthe unmanned ship and the underwater robot is guaranteed.

title: Underwater charging device for submersible vehicle and realization method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater charging device for a submersible vehicle and a realization method thereof. The underwater charging device comprises a charging base module, wherein the chargingbase module is of a right angular structure; a charging socket and a steel wire rope connector are arranged at the inner side of the vertical right angle edge of the charging base module; a chargingclamp module is arranged on the horizontal right angle edge; the charging clamp module is connected with the steel wire rope connector on the charging base module through the steel wire rope; a hydraulic locking mechanism is arranged inside the charging clamp module; meanwhile, a charging connector module is also arranged inside the charging clamp module; the head part of the charging connector module is connected with the charging socket. The underwater charging device has the advantages that the structure is compact and reasonable; the operation is convenient; an ROV is arranged through a nuclear power submersible vehicle; the underwater charging device is operated to charge the conventional submersible vehicle under the water; the underwater operation duration of the submersible vehiclecan be effectively prolonged; the submersible vehicle exposure rate is reduced; the execution of invisible operation tasks by the submersible vehicle is facilitated.

title: Underwater robot target detection method based on machine vision
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater robot target detection method based on machine vision, which belongs to the technical field of image processing, and comprises the following steps: after shooting underwater images, respectively extracting contour feature maps of a plurality of underwater images so as to highlight the features of the underwater images, and then taking the geometric center of the contour in each current contour feature map as an original point to obtain a target detection result; the pixel point coordinates of each current contour feature map are reconstructed to obtain a plurality of current contour registration maps, and after reconstruction, the differences of the contours on the current contour registration maps are easier to compare, and the current contour registration maps with different feature quantities are selected, so that the processing of underwater images with the same content is avoided, the redundant image data is solved, and the processing efficiency is improved. The number of underwater images needing to be processed by the target extraction neural network is reduced, and then the target extraction neural network is adopted to process each to-be-processed feature map to obtain a target area; according to the method, the contour feature map is firstly extracted, so that interference factors in the underwater environment are greatly reduced, and the accuracy of target detection is improved.

title: ROBOT SUBACQUEO COMANDATO A DISTANZA
3-D IMAGING AND/OR FLOW ESTIMATION WITH A ROW-COLUMN ADDRESSED 2-D TRANSDUCER ARRAY
abstract: An ultrasound imaging system (100) includes a 2-D transducer array (102) with a first 1-D array (104, 204) of one or more rows of transducing elements (106, 2041, . . . 2046) configured to produce first ultrasound data and a second 1-D array (104, 206) of one or more columns of transducing elements (106, 2061, . . . 2066) configured to produce second ultrasound data. The first and second 1-D arrays are configured for row-column addressing. The ultrasound imaging system further includes a controller (112) configured to control transmission and reception of the first and second 1-D arrays, and a beamformer (114) configured to beamform the received first and second echoes to produce ultrasound data, and an image processor (116) configured to process the ultrasound data to generate an image, which is displayed via a display (224).

title: AUV-based small-vector tail propeller device and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a small vector control tail thruster design device based on underwater robot (AUV) design and a control method. The small vector control tail thruster design device is provided with a sealing mechanism, a thruster transmission mechanism, a rotary steering engine fixing mechanism and a controller. According to the device, the movement direction of the AUV is controlled by controlling the orientation of the propeller through the two steering engines, the steering function of a rudder is replaced to a certain extent, and the movement direction of the AUV can be controlled in a vector mode by changing the deflection angle of the rudder according to the actual yaw condition. The invention relates to a control method of a sliding mode variable structure, which is used for carrying out speed control and depth control on navigation of an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle), reducing problems and difficulty caused by a parameter setting process and realizing a faster and more stable control effect.

title: Unmanned underwater vehicle path-finding training method and device and unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned underwater vehicle path-finding training method and device and an unmanned underwater vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned underwater vehicles. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the unmanned underwater vehicle can be trained on the basis of continuous judgment and correction of the execution decision of underwater vehicle path finding, so that the unmanned underwater vehicle has certain autonomous judgment capability. The unmanned aerial vehicle trained by the method provided by the invention can smoothly pass through an unfamiliar water area in manners of avoiding, detouring and the like when facing an obstacle according to experience obtained by self training even in a complex underwater environment. Meanwhile, by utilizing the training method provided by the invention, the closer the water area for training the unmanned underwater vehicle is to the actual combat, the more the unmanned underwater vehicle has the capability of automatically finding the way in the actual combat environment, so that the unmanned underwater vehicle can smoothly arrive at the target site to complete the distributed task.

title: 1500-meter-level hybrid drive type underwater glider
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater robots, and particularly relates to a 1500-meter-level hybrid drive type underwater glider which comprises a glider body, a main control system, a buoyancy adjusting system, a pitching adjusting system, a steering adjusting system, an energy system, a navigation communication system, an emergency load rejection system and a propeller system. The main control system controls the buoyancy adjusting system to adjust the buoyancy of the glider; the pitching adjusting system adjusts the pitching posture by adjusting the position of the gravity center; the steering adjusting system realizes steering motion by adjusting a steering mechanism; the energy system provides energy for all actions of the glider; the navigation communication system is usedfor positioning tracking and data transmission; the emergency load rejection system guarantees recovery when the glider breaks down; and the main control system controls the propeller system to realize accelerated propelling motion. The glider can be widely applied to the rapid detection of water area information and the like.

title: AUV docking station optical guiding method based on monocular vision
abstract: The invention provides an AUV docking station optical guiding method based on monocular vision. The AUV docking station optical guiding method comprises: arranging a guiding light source; shooting an underwater guide light source image through a monocular camera, wherein the monocular camera is calibrated by adopting an improved Zhang Zhengyou calibration method; acquiring an underwater nonlinear imaging model of the camera, and mapping the guide light source image into the air through a pixel correction formula to generate a corrected image; carrying out light source segmentation on the corrected image based on an improved adaptive OTSU algorithm, and calculating and obtaining a light source center coordinate based on a coordinate of a pixel weighted centroid; and based on the center coordinates of the light source, performing P3P calculation on three pairs of known coordinate points to calculate the pose of the camera so as to obtain relative position information of the camera.

title: UNDERWATER GLIDER FOR LOCALIZING A SOURCE OF SOUND
abstract: FIELD: acoustics.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to devices for localizing a sound source. Underwater glider contains wings, rudders, engines, battery, control system. Glider contains two spaced apart detectors – fore and aft. Each detector is covered with a soundproof cover and is mounted on the longitudinal of the elastic threads. Data processing system includes a two-channel ADC whose outputs are connected to two-channel units for calculating the vertical and horizontal components of the intensity vector. Horizontal component calculation unit is associated with the azimuth angle calculation unit, aggregate azimuth angle calculation unit, and horizontal component differentiation unit. Unit for calculating the vertical component of the intensity vector is associated with the unit for differentiating the vertical component of the vector. In turn, the differentiation units of both components of the vector are connected with the unit for calculating the horizontal components of the intensity vector rotor, which, in its turn, is connected to the unit for calculating the angular component of the intensity rotor vector in a rotated coordinate system. Unit for calculating an angular component of an intensity rotor vector in a rotated coordinate system is associated with a block for calculating the maximum value of an angular component of an intensity vector rotor.EFFECT: higher accuracy and range of detection of a source of sound.3 cl, 3 dwg

title: Video image real-time enhancement method for underwater AUV
abstract: The invention discloses a video image real-time enhancement method for an underwater AUV. The method comprises the steps of acquiring a sample; constructing a generative adversarial network and training the generative adversarial network; and collecting underwater image data as input of the generative adversarial network, generating a clear image corresponding to a underwater distortion image by using the trained generative adversarial network, and then outputting the clear image as a video stream so that real-time enhancement of the underwater image can be realized. The problem of underwaterimage distortion is solved, real-time image enhancement is realized, and a visual perception capability of the underwater robot is improved.

title: INSPECTION AND/OR MAINTENANCE METHOD AND ASSOCIATED APPARATUS
abstract: A method of isolating a sea chest of a marine vessel. The method comprises sealing an inlet (12, Fig 4) to the sea chest with an isolation apparatus 20. The isolation apparatus is both transported through a body of water adjacent the vessel and positioned to cover the inlet using a diverless operation. The method may further comprise transporting the isolation apparatus through the body of water by lowering it on an elongate member (19, Fig 6) to a depth corresponding to the inlet and positioning the isolation apparatus to cover the inlet using an ROV 50. An isolation apparatus comprising a blanking plate and configured for use in the method is also disclosed.

title: Control System for a Cable Operated ROV
abstract: The present invention solves the foregoing problems by providing a control system comprising a remote control module in wireless communication with a cable reel module connected to a motor operated cable reel. Advantageously, the remote control module comprises a first user interface for entering instructions and a processor for transmitting the instructions to the cable reel module to extend or retract the cable and thus control the ascent or descent of an ROV attached to the cable. Due to the processor-controlled nature of the control system automated operations of ROV ascent and descent can be realised. Furthermore, the cable reel module itself is provided with a second user interface that can enact a manual override and emergency stop of the ROV motion in the event that the remote control aspect malfunctions or is being operated incorrectly.

title: Rapid positioning search and rescue device and use method thereof
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a rapid positioning search and rescue device and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ship search and rescue, and the device comprises a communication main control module which is connected with a satellite signal and is used for achieving the rapid positioning of an underwater vehicle or a ship; the stroboscopic alarm module is arranged on a ship bow part of an underwater vehicle or a ship, the communication master control module is connected with the stroboscopic alarm module, and the stroboscopic alarm module is used for sound-light alarm; and the adjusting module is used for expanding the installation interface. By arranging the communication master control module, the automatic star finding and positioning function is achieved when the ship floats upwards, and by arranging the adjusting module to expand the installation interface, it can be guaranteed that the ship or the underwater vehicle is positioned and salvaged in time in the ship test trial process.

title: Swimming pool cleaning base, cleaning system and control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of swimming pool cleaning, and provides a swimming pool cleaning base, a cleaning system and a control method.The base comprises a bearing assembly, a lifting assembly and a rotating assembly, the lifting assembly comprises a lifting structure, the bearing assembly comprises a bearing panel and a rotating panel which are connected, and the bearing panel can stretch out and draw back in a stacked mode relative to the rotating panel; the rotating assembly can rotate downwards towards the connection end relative to the lifting structure and comprises a rotating support, and the rotating support can drive the filtering unit to rotate. When the base station is in a first state, the lifting structure is in a lowered state, the bearing panel is in a retracted state, the rotating panel is in a first direction, the swimming pool robot stops on the bearing panel, and the rotating support is connected to the swimming pool robot; in the second state, the lifting structure is in a lifting state, the rotating panel rotates to the second direction relative to the lifting structure, and the bearing panel extends out in the second direction relative to the rotating panel. The swimming pool robot has the advantages that the base can be conveniently fished and cleaned, and labor cost is reduced.

title: Target acoustic imaging and velocity measurement method and system based on pulse pair emission
abstract: The invention provides a target acoustic imaging and velocity measurement method and system based on pulse pair emission. The method comprises the following steps: applying pulse pair signals producedby a signal generator on an emission energy converter through a power amplifier, and radiating acoustic wave to a medium; receiving echo signals formed by the radiation acoustic wave through target scattering in the medium through all array elements of a receiving energy converter array, and converting signals of all array element receiving channels into digital signals through multi-channel signal collection; performing delay superposition processing on receiving channel digital signals through the digital signal processor, accomplishing the computation on all scanning beams to obtain the beamforming result; and according to the beamforming result, obtaining radial speed estimation of the target per-pixel, extracting time domain signal envelope of the beam, and accomplishing the computation of the scanning beam to obtain a scanned acoustic image. The speed estimation is performed on the pixels including point target when the acoustic imaging is realized, thereby acquiring the radialspeed estimation of all targets in the dielectric.

title: COMMUNICATION SYSTEM
abstract: To allow for communication between an apparatus received in a control board and an external terminal, without opening the control board door.SOLUTION: A communication system includes one or more controller apparatus 1 received in a control board 5, and performing input-output of signals, an external terminal 2 for inputting and outputting signals, a supersonic wave transmitter-receiver 3 attached to the controller apparatus 1, individually, and a supersonic wave transmitter-receiver 4 connected with the external terminal 2. Each supersonic wave transmitter-receiver 3 has a transmission section 31 for converting a signal outputted from the controller apparatus 1, to which the own machine is connected, into ultrasonic waves and conducting it to the control board 5, a receiving part 32 for receiving the ultrasonic waves, conducted to the control board 5, and converting it into a signal, and an output part 33 for outputting a signal, obtained from the receiving part 32, to the controller apparatus 1 to which the own machine is connected. The supersonic wave transmitter-receiver 4 has a transmission section 41 abutting on the control board 5, and converting a signal outputted from the external terminal 2 into ultrasonic waves and conducting it to the control board 5, a receiving part 42 abutting on the control board 5, and receiving the ultrasonic waves conducted to the control board 5 and converting it into signals, and an output part 43 for outputting a signal, obtained by the receiving part 42, to the external terminal 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Tendon rope driven underwater dexterous hand
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater dexterous hand driven by a tendon rope, and relates to the technical field of underwater dexterous hands. In order to overcome the defects that in the prior art, an existing operation type underwater robot is single in grabbing mode and poor in flexibility, and the technical problem that a conventional underwater mechanical arm is difficult to conduct efficient, lossless and self-adaptive grabbing on underwater creatures, the technical scheme is that the tendon rope driven underwater dexterous hand is provided. Which comprises a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger, and is characterized in that the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger comprise far knuckles, middle knuckles and near knuckles and simulate human knuckles; the thumb comprises near knuckles and far knuckles and simulates knuckles of human beings; the palm simulates the shape of a human palm and is respectively connected with the near knuckles of the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger. The self-adaptive grabbing device is suitable for being applied to efficient and lossless self-adaptive grabbing work of underwater organisms through a mechanical arm.

title: BOTTOM-MOUNTED MEASUREMENT FRAME FOR MUDDY-COAST SOFT-SOIL WATERS
abstract: The invention discloses a bottom-supported observation support suitable for a muddy coast soft mud substrate sea area, which is made of stainless steel and is characterized in that a main body of the support is a three-legged support, the top of the three-legged support is provided with a mounting disc, the mounting disc is supported by three support legs which are uniformly distributed along the circumferential direction, and the three support legs are connected with the bottom of the three-legged support. The bottoms of every two adjacent supporting legs are connected through a transverse support, anti-sedimentation balance weight plates are connected to every two adjacent transverse supports, and the three anti-sedimentation balance weight plates are evenly arranged in the circumferential direction. According to the characteristic that the silt coast substrate is soft, the anti-sedimentation counterweight plate is specially designed, and natural sedimentation is reduced by increasing the bottom area of the frame body; meanwhile, aiming at the characteristic of light dead weight of the frame body, the frame body can also be used as a counterweight to keep the frame body balanced and stable. The device is made of stainless steel and resistant to seawater corrosion. The self-weight of the support in the air is about 40 kilograms, and the main body is made of stainless steel channel steel, so that the support is light in weight and convenient to transport, put and recycle.

title: RECEPTACLE A COMPARTIMENTS ETANCHES ET PROCEDE DE MISE EN PLACE POUR RECUPERER DES EFFLUENTS POLLUANTS D'UNE EPAVE
abstract: The invention concerns the use of a buoyancy fluid having a density lower than that of sea water confined in sealed rigid or flexible envelope (41, 191), to form an immersed buoyancy element (4, 19). The invention is characterized in that said buoyancy fluid is a compound occurring naturally in gaseous state at ambient temperature and pressure and in liquid state at the underwater depth whereat said element is immersed. The invention also concerns a method for setting between the surface and the sea floor a buoyancy element characterized in that said fluid is stored in a tank on a ship (61) at the surface in liquid state compressed or cooled, and it is injected in liquid state into a pipe (23) from the surface (61) where it is stored up to said one envelope (41, 191) immersed at an underwater depth whereat the underwater pressure is not less than the vapour pressure of the gas corresponding to said compound.

title: WATER RESCUE ROBOT
abstract: The invention relates to a water rescue robot having an underwater vehicle (1) which can be remote-controlled or which is autonomous and which has a rescue attachment (2) that is rigidly or releasably connected to the underwater vehicle (1). The rescue attachment (2) has a person securing structure for a person (7) to be received and multiple floating units (5, 6) with a controllable degree of buoyancy. The water rescue robot additionally has a sensor system for detecting the position of a person (7) to be received in the water and a controller which maneuvers the underwater vehicle (1) below the person (7), raises the underwater vehicle until the person (7) is received by the person securing structure, and then actuates the floating units (5, 6) in order to generate buoyancy, by means of which the rescue attachment (2) together with the received person (7) is brought to the surface of the water. The water rescue robot allows an automatic rescue of drowning persons.

title: DISTANCE MEASURING DEVICE, DISTANCE MEASUREMENT METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: A technology of the present invention relates to a distance measurement device, a distance measurement method, and a program that enable the distance to a target to be accurately measured. A distance measurement device according to one aspect of the technology of the present invention comprises: an OFDM modulation unit that generates an OFDM signal by performing OFDM modulation on a transmission signal; an output unit that outputs the OFDM signal using an ultrasonic wave as a carrier wave; a sound collecting unit that collects, as a reception signal, ultrasonic waves that are reflected waves resulting from the ultrasonic waves output from the output unit being reflected by a target; a demodulation unit that generates a demodulated signal by demodulating the reception signal; a calculation unit that calculates a delay profile on the basis of an own signal obtained in the process of generating the OFDM signal and the demodulated signal; and an arithmetic unit that obtains a delay time of the ultrasonic waves from the delay profile and calculates the distance to the target on the basis of the delay time. The technology of the present invention can be applied to an automobile, for example.

title: Electrically-driven winch power supply device for ROV
abstract: The invention provides an electric drive winch power supply device for an ROV (remote operated vehicle), which comprises a cabinet body and a control system, a transformer unit cabinet, a control unit cabinet, a main power unit cabinet and a water cooling system are sequentially arranged in the cabinet body along the transverse direction, a water-air heat exchange system is further arranged at the top of the cabinet body, and the water-air heat exchange system is connected with one group of interfaces of the water cooling system. The water cooling system is further provided with a secondary water connector, and the control system is electrically connected with the water cooling system and the water-air heat exchange system. The water-water heat exchange mode and the water-air heat exchange mode are compatible, graded water-cooling heat dissipation and independent cavity forming of the high-temperature area and the low-temperature area are achieved, and different engineering ship conditions are adapted while the reliability is improved; the total power and cost of the water-cooling system are reduced.

title: Bionic underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, in particular to a bionic underwater robot which comprises a robot body and a tail fin. A power module is arranged in the machine body; the power module comprises a first bracket and a second bracket; the connecting shaft is sleeved with a mounting frame, and one end of the first support and one end of the second support are connected with the mounting frame. Two mounting plates are further mounted in the rack, and two propelling assemblies are arranged on the mounting plates; the propelling assembly comprises a first rotating shaft, a mounting disc and a shifting rod; the first rotating shaft is rotationally mounted on the mounting plate; the mounting disc sleeves the first rotating shaft; the two ends of the shifting rod are connected with the two mounting discs respectively; and the driving device is mounted on the mounting plate. The function of controlling the tail fin to swing in a reciprocating mode is achieved, the effect that impact borne by the tail fin during turning is buffered through water flow resistance borne by swing of the tail fin is achieved through alternate driving of the two propelling assemblies, and the problem that the endurance time of the robot can be greatly shortened due to the fact that a damping mechanism and an elastic mechanism are used for controlling the swing frequency is solved.

title: Underwater robot cable winch and winding measurement control system thereof
abstract: The underwater robot cable winch and the winding measurement control system thereof comprise a roller used for winding a cable and a cable arrangement assembly used for straightening and limiting the cable, and the cable arrangement assembly is arranged on the peripheral side of the roller and can slide in the cable winding process; the roller comprises a rolling shaft and supporting wheels located at the two ends of the rolling shaft, an arc-shaped cover is arranged between the two supporting wheels, and the arc-shaped cover and the surface of the rolling shaft are spaced. The side, facing the rolling shaft, of the arc-shaped cover is provided with a distance measuring dot matrix used for measuring the distance between the inner wall of the arc-shaped cover and the surface of the cable. The supporting wheel is provided with a laser sensing dot matrix used for sensing whether the cable exists on each layer in the radial direction. A signal transmitting device is arranged on the cable arranging assembly, a receiving dot matrix is arranged on the side wall, away from the rolling shaft, of the arc-shaped cover, and the receiving dot matrix and the distance measuring dot matrix are arranged in the axial direction of the arc-shaped cover and correspond in a one-to-one mode in the axial direction of the arc-shaped cover. According to the cable storage device, cables can be stored more regularly and are not prone to winding and knotting.

title: METHOD FOR CHECKING THE ENVIRONMENT OF A MOTOR VEHICLE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for checking the environment of a motor vehicle, wherein the environment of the motor vehicle is captured in a first step before and during a parking procedure, the captured data of the motor vehicle are stored, and the stored data are checked for plausibility when the motor vehicle is started again.

title: System and method based on marine ecological environment inspection
abstract: Disclosed are a system and a method based on marine ecological environment inspection. The system comprises an unmanned underwater vehicle, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a data processing device. Theunmanned underwater vehicle is configured to autonomously travel to a preset inspection area and monitor the data of the seabed environment in the preset inspection area; the unmanned aerial vehicleis mounted on the unmanned underwater vehicle and is launched after the unmanned underwater vehicle travels to the preset inspection area; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for acquiring picture data of the sea surface in the preset inspection area, and transmitting the picture data to the unmanned underwater vehicle; and the unmanned underwater vehicle is further used for transmitting the picture data to the data processing device. According to the marine ecological environment inspection system and method, compared with the existing marine ecological environment inspection activity, the system has the advantages of being high in inspection efficiency, large in inspection scope, low in cost, high in efficiency, high in personnel coefficient and the like.

title: Data-driven AUV multidisciplinary optimization method based on state matching
abstract: The invention discloses a data-driven AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) multidisciplinary optimization method based on state matching, which comprises the following steps of: determining disciplines related to an AUV design optimization problem and design variables related to each discipline; setting an optimization target and a constraint condition of the design optimization problem; constructing an analysis environment of the design optimization problem, wherein the analysis environment comprises a shape subject analysis environment, a fluid subject analysis environment, a layout subject analysis environment and a structure subject analysis environment; the genetic algorithm is initialized; in the design space range of the AUV, initial design samples are generated, each design sample is composed of a set of design variables, each design sample serves as an individual, and an initial population is constructed; evaluating a population state and determining an optimization strategy; and aiming at the determined optimization strategy, solving by adopting a genetic algorithm based on an agent model, screening out a non-dominated solution set meeting constraint conditions, and outputting a design vector corresponding to an individual contained in the non-dominated solution set as an AUV optimization design scheme.

title: Ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus for estimating position of probe and method for controlling the same
abstract: The ultrasonic diagnostic apparatus in accordance with embodiments of the present disclosure, the current position of the ultrasonic probe is estimated using an ultrasound signal transmitted for creation of an ultrasound image without attachment of an extra sensor, so the position of the ultrasonic probe may be estimated more economically and effectively.

title: Visual positioning and close-range dense formation method for underwater robot cluster
abstract: The invention discloses a visual positioning and close-range dense formation method for an underwater robot cluster. The method comprises a vector and scalar marker lamp group module, an omnidirectional underwater high-definition camera module and an image processing and formation control module. When a plurality of underwater robots execute a formation task, all the underwater robots turn on the vector and scalar marker lamps and acquire optical images formed by the vector or scalar marker lamps of other adjacent underwater robots through the omni-directional underwater high-definition camera group; and image processing is carried out on the obtained image, calculating space three-dimensional coordinates and postures of a plurality of adjacent underwater robot targets, and a control instruction is calculated according to a formation task to form a stable underwater robot formation. According to the method, high-precision visual positioning is realized on an underwater robot carrier, and stable underwater robot cluster formation under a non-communication condition is realized on the basis. An underwater robot cluster carrying the method can freely switch the formation in autonomous navigation without modifying any hardware settings.

title: Sea-air cooperative anti-ocean current interference navigation method based on vision assistance
abstract: The invention discloses a sea-air cooperative ocean current interference resisting navigation method based on vision assistance, which comprises the following steps: acquiring video sequence information of an aerial-view sea area of an airspace through an airspace unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain position information of a remote-control unmanned submersible and ocean current information of the sea area, and providing assistance for navigation of the remote-control unmanned submersible. And meanwhile, an ocean current interference resisting algorithm is added to a control algorithm part of the remote control unmanned submersible, so that the problems of position drift and poor control precision of the remote control unmanned submersible caused by environmental influence of ocean current and the like are solved, and the control and navigation precision of the remote control unmanned submersible is effectively improved.

title: AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) multi-sensor fusion positioning method based on frequency domain two-dimensional collaborative characteristics
abstract: The invention discloses an AUV (Autonomous Underwater Vehicle) multi-sensor fusion positioning method based on frequency domain two-dimensional collaborative features. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-sensor time sequence data and an AUV track truth value of time step alignment in a simulation scene; an AUV positioning prediction model is constructed, the AUV positioning prediction model is used for performing frequency domain analysis on the multi-sensor time sequence data along the time dimension and the sensor dimension through a two-dimensional feature transformation module, a dominant frequency is extracted and remodeled, and a remodeled sequence is obtained; a multi-scale feature extraction module extracts multi-dimensional features of the remolded sequence in parallel through multi-scale convolution and fuses the multi-dimensional features to obtain fused features; the adaptive multi-cycle aggregation module weights the fusion features and performs residual connection with multi-sensor time sequence data so as to obtain an AUV prediction position; training an AUV positioning prediction model based on multi-sensor time sequence data and an AUV trajectory truth value; and acquiring multi-sensor data, and realizing AUV positioning based on the trained model.

title: Method and device for many-to-many pursuit game of unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a many-to-many pursuit and escape game method and device for unmanned underwater vehicles, and relates to the technical field of cluster control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the positions of a plurality of vehicles, the vehicles comprising pursuit parties and escape parties; respectively constructing motion models of the aircraft based on the position of the aircraft; based on cooperative detection, the pursuing party locates the escape party and determines a target escape object, and the escape party locates the pursuing party and determines a target pursuing object; based on the target pursuit object and the target escape object, establishing a first optimization algorithm between the pursuit party and the target escape object and a second optimization algorithm between the escape party and the target pursuit object; and jointly solving the first optimization algorithm and the second optimization algorithm, and determining the behavior action of the pursuit party and the behavior action of the escape party. According to the invention, many-to-many pursuit game control of the unmanned underwater vehicle can be realized.

title: WIRED/WIRELESS CHARGING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ELECTRIC CAR AND ELECTRIC VEHICLE
abstract: A wheeled wired/wireless charging device is formed in an L shape and has: a wheeled charging connector, equipped with a battery having a body in a hexahedral shape and the like, or a port for connecting the charging connector; a plug and a handle for charging the battery having the body in a hexahedral shape and the like; and a wireless charging pad, formed in a flat shape so as to be placed beneath car wheels, or a wireless charging device having a magnetic resonance transmission unit coil. A transmission and reception device of the wireless charging device which has wheels formed on the bottom surface thereof allows a wireless charging transmission device to be placed on the bottom surface of a car from one side of a battery having a body in a hexahedral shape and the like, and performs wireless charging by interacting with a wireless charging reception device on the bottom surface of the car. Wired charging is performed by connecting the wheeled charging connector equipped with the battery having the body in a hexahedral shape and the like to a charging inlet of the electric car or by connecting the charging connector to the port for connecting the charging connector and connecting the charging connector to the charging inlet of the electric car. The battery of the wired/wireless charging device is charged by plugging a plug, for charging the battery having the body in a hexahedral shape and the like, in an outlet.

title: Flexible bionic robotic fish capable of changing rigidity of fish body on line
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and provides a flexible bionic robotic fish with on-line variable fish body rigidity, which comprises a bionic fish head and a flexible bionic fish body, and the bionic fish head is connected with the flexible bionic fish body; the flexible bionic robotic fish further comprises a variable-rigidity mechanism, the variable-rigidity mechanism comprises a telescopic assembly located in the bionic fish head and a flexible bionic spine located in the flexible bionic fish body, and the telescopic assembly and the flexible bionic spine are oppositely arranged. Wherein the telescopic assembly is used for doing telescopic motion in the direction of a connecting line between the bionic fish head and the flexible bionic fish body, and the flexible bionic spine is compressed or released through the telescopic motion of the telescopic assembly so as to change the rigidity of the flexible bionic fish body. The flexible bionic robotic fish capable of changing the rigidity of the fish body on line is flexible in movement and stable in shape of the fish body, and the rigidity of the fish body can be changed in the swimming process.

title: Sound wave communication method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention discloses a sound wave communication method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out channel coding on a first digital signal to obtain a coded second digital signal; inserting a code element synchronization head into the second digital signal to obtain a third digital signal; performing multi-system modulation on the third digital signal by using a plurality of sound wave frequency points corresponding to the target sound wave frequency band to obtain a modulated sound wave modulation signal; inserting a framesynchronization head in front of the sound wave modulation signal to obtain a to-be-transmitted sound wave signal; and transmitting the acoustic wave signal by using the first baseband frequency. According to the invention, the technical problem of low voice signal receiving accuracy caused by signal attenuation in the prior art is solved.

title: Underwater remote positioning system, method, device, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater remote positioning system, method, device and equipment and a medium, which are applied to the technical field of underwater positioning and are used for solving the problems of complex buoy deployment and waste of positioning resources of an underwater remote positioning system in the prior art. The method specifically comprises the following steps: receiving an acoustic positioning signal emitted by an underwater robot through a plurality of positioning buoys arranged on the water surface and a shipborne response device positioned in a measurement mother ship, and sending the position coordinate of the acoustic positioning signal and the propagation time delay between the acoustic positioning signal and the underwater robot to a shipborne control device for positioning calculation; three-dimensional positioning of the underwater robot can be achieved, meanwhile, the shipborne response equipment which is located in the measurement mother ship and used for achieving acoustic communication between the shipborne control equipment and the underwater robot is reused as the positioning buoys, the number of the positioning buoys distributed on the water surface can be reduced, and the positioning accuracy of the underwater robot can be improved. The deployment difficulty and complexity of the positioning buoy on the water surface are reduced, reuse of positioning resources can be realized, and the utilization rate of the positioning resources is improved.

title: Umbilical cable exit tool for underwater robot
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater robot auxiliary tool, in particular to an umbilical cable exit tool for an underwater robot. The umbilical cable exit tool comprises a supporting barrel body, asleeve seat, supporting arms, supporting plates, a cable exiting push rod and a hydraulic cylinder, wherein the sleeve seat is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the supporting barrel body, a sleeveseat shoulder is arranged on the inner side of the sleeve seat, the supporting arms are fixedly arranged on the sleeve seat, the upper ends of the supporting arms are connected with the supporting plates through pin rolls, the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly arranged on the supporting plates, and the cable exiting push rod is arranged at the end part of a cylinder rod of the hydraulic cylinder. When the mechanism works, a umbilical cable tail end is arranged in the supporting barrel body, a umbilical cable tail end clamping ring at the upper end of the umbilical cable tail end abuts against thesleeve seat shoulder, and the cable exiting push rod abuts against the upper end face of an umbilical cable in the umbilical cable tail end and is driven to move through the hydraulic cylinder. The tool has the advantages that operation is stable, reliable, convenient and fast, and serious damage to the umbilical cable tail end is avoided.

title: BUOY FOR DETECTING WAVE-DRIFT CURRENT
abstract: The present invention relates to a device to observe wave induced-current and, more specifically, to a device to observe wave induced-current capable of observing current flow (wave induced-current) of the sea using a GPS transmitter. A propeller is installed through a height adjusting member while a side flow plate to observe current flow is formed on a self-propelled buoy having the propeller. The propeller is moved on the surface of the water when the buoy moves and is exposed to the outside of the water surface when the current flow is observed not to be affected from the current flow. A deployment wing of the side flow plate is installed to be stored in a frame. The deployment wing is deployed only when the current flow is observed in order for the buoy to be raised depending on the current flow. The deployment wing is stored in the frame not to interfere with the sailing of the buoy when the buoy moves.

title: Underwater fish catching method based on image processing
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater fish catching method based on image processing. The method includes the steps that firstly, an underwater fish catching platform based on image processing is provided, the catching platform comprises an underwater robot body, a fish detecting device and an overwater processing device, and the fish detecting device is located on the underwater robot body and used for detecting whether fish exists underwater or not and transmitting relevant information of the fish to the overwater processing device through the underwater robot body when the fish is detected; secondly, the catching platform is used for catching fish. By means of the underwater fish catching method based on image processing, the underwater fish can be automatically recognized, the recognized underwater fish is positioned and caught, and therefore the underwater fish catching difficulty is reduced.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR OPERATION OF MULTIAXIAL ULTRASOUND TRANSDUCERS
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for performing ultrasound imaging using biphasic driving and/or reception for ferroelectric ultrasound elements having propagation and lateral electrode pairs. Electrode pairs are driven using biphasic drive signals, where the drive signals applied to the respective pairs of electrodes are provided with a phase difference therebetween, and where a time delay may be added between the drive signals to further increase the power of the emitted ultrasound. In some example embodiments, passive determination of the direction and/or location of an acoustic source relative to a multiaxial ultrasound transducer is determined based on the voltages detected at the propagation electrodes and the lateral electrodes the multiaxial transducer, according to a pre-determined relationship between the electrode voltages and one or more directional angles. A plurality of multiaxial ultrasound transducers may be employed to improve the accuracy of the estimated direction and/or location of the acoustic source.

title: Battery pack and cooling device for UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle)
abstract: The invention discloses a battery pack for a UUV (Unmanned Underwater Vehicle) and a cooling device, and relates to the technical field of battery pack heat dissipation. The cooling device comprises a front heat dissipation end plate, a front capillary tube welding plate, a cooling capillary tube, a rear capillary tube welding plate and a rear heat dissipation end plate, cooling fins are arranged on the outer side of the front heat dissipation end plate, a communication water channel is milled in the inner side of the front heat dissipation end plate, and one end of the cooling capillary tube is fixed through the front capillary tube welding plate and communicated through the communication water channel of the front heat dissipation end plate; radiating fins are arranged on the outer side of the rear radiating end plate, communicating water channels are milled on the inner side of the rear radiating end plate, and the other ends of the cooling capillary tubes are fixed through a rear capillary tube welding plate and are communicated through the communicating water channels of the rear radiating end plate; the cooling capillary tube penetrates through the unit battery of the UUV, and the penetrating direction of the cooling capillary tube is the same as the axial direction of the single battery in the unit battery. According to the invention, cooling of the UUV battery pack can be realized under a relatively high-rate discharge working condition.

title: ３次元（３Ｄ）横断方向振動ベクトル速度超音波画像
abstract: 超音波画像システム（３００）は、超音波信号を送信し、エコーを受信するように構成されるトランスデューサー素子の２次元アレイを備えるトランスデューサーアレイ（３０２）と、視野を通過するように超音波信号を送信するためにトランスデューサーアレイを制御するように構成される送信回路（３０４）と、視野内の構造体を通過する超音波信号に応答して作り出される２次元の一連のエコーを受信するように構成される受信回路（３０６）と、を含み、この構造体は流動する構造体を含む。ビームフォーマ（３１２）は、エコーをビーム形成するように構成され、速度プロセッサ（３１４）は、奥行方向速度成分と、横断方向速度成分と、高さ方向速度成分とを別々に決定するように構成され、速度成分が、同一の送信した超音波信号と同一の受信した一連の２次元のエコーとに基づいて決定される。【選択図】 第３図

title: Bionic underwater vehicle
abstract: The bionic underwater vehicle comprises a shell assembly and a driving assembly, the shell assembly comprises a bionic shell, the interior of the bionic shell is hollow, through holes are formed in the two back-to-back sides of the bionic shell respectively, and the driving assembly comprises two flapping fins, two propeller parts and at least one first driving part; the two flapping fins are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the bionic shell, connected to the bionic shell and used for driving the bionic shell to advance and turn, the propeller part is slidably connected to the bionic shell in the axial direction of the through hole, and the first driving part is connected to the propeller part and used for driving the propeller part to slide into or slide out of the bionic shell in the axial direction of the through hole. When the propeller part is located outside the bionic shell, the propeller part is used for pushing the bionic shell to move forwards, turn and retreat. The problem that in the prior art, only propeller propelling or fin flapping gliding is used as power, and therefore the movement requirement of ocean observation in a complex sea area cannot be met in a matched mode can be solved.

title: Hybrid power unmanned sailing boat driven by wave energy, solar energy and wind energy
abstract: The invention discloses a hybrid power unmanned sailing boat driven by wave energy, solar energy and wind energy, which can carry related water quality detection sensors and camera monitoring equipment and is used for mobile cruise monitoring and water quality detection in a large water area space. The ship structurally comprises an overwater ship body part, an underwater umbilical cord and an underwater glider, the overwater ship body part comprises a wind energy unit, a solar energy unit and an overwater control unit; the underwater glider comprises an underwater structure unit, an underwater control unit and an underwater movement unit. The whole system can realize multi-source power fusion on an energy structure through complementation and coordination of wind energy, wave energy and light energy, and can effectively cope with various weather environments and different surrounding natural conditions in the operation process so as to complete long-term operation tasks.

title: Rapid buoyancy adjusting system for small and medium-sized unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid buoyancy adjusting system for a small and medium-sized unmanned underwater vehicle. The rapid buoyancy adjusting system comprises a storage water tank, a first water pump, a second water pump, a first one-way valve, a second one-way valve, a first liquid level sensor, a second liquid level sensor, a third liquid level sensor, a fourth liquid level sensor, a third one-way valve and a fourth one-way valve. A top cover, a water passing hole and an inlet connector are fixed to the top of the storage water tank, and a water collecting groove and an outlet connector are arranged at the bottom of the storage water tank. The first liquid level sensor, the second liquid level sensor, the third one-way valve and the fourth one-way valve are all installed on the top cover. And the third liquid level sensor and the fourth liquid level sensor are arranged at the water collecting groove. The side wall of the storage water tank is provided with a fixing frame used forbeing fixedly connected with an underwater vehicle. A water flow inlet of the first water pump is connected with a bottom outlet joint of the storage water tank; a water outlet of the first water pumpis connected with the first one-way valve, and a water outlet of the second water pump is sequentially connected with the second one-way valve, the water injection pipe and the storage water tank.

title: Simulation/graph display cabinet applied to underwater unmanned vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to a simulation/graph display cabinet applied to an underwater unmanned vehicle. The cabinet comprises an upper cabinet body and a lower cabinet body, wherein a dual-redundancy interchanger in the upper cabinet body is connected to a control computer and conducts data interaction with the control computer; the dual-redundancy interchanger is also connected to a network interchanger; a graph display computer is connected to a display for data display, is connected to a keyboard and a mouse, and is connected to the interchangers for dual-way communication; in the lower cabinet body, the control computer is connected to a simulation industrial control computer by a simulation signal control box for data communication; and the simulation industrial control computer is connected to the interchangers and a keyboard-display all-in-one machine. The cabinet disclosed by the invention is used to simulate internal and external environments during sailing of the unmanned underwater vehicle, so the vehicle can run in a virtual environment. Furthermore, correctness, validly and reliability of system control software of the unmanned underwater vehicle can be ensured.

title: Negative buoyancy compensation device applied to unmanned underwater vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a negative buoyancy compensation device applied to an unmanned underwater vehicle. The negative buoyancy compensation device can quickly perform negative buoyancy compensation on the vehicle. The negative buoyancy compensation device comprises a buoyancy compensation water tank, a linear motor, an upper push rod, a lower push rod, an upper sealing plug and a lower sealing plug. Two ends of a motor shaft of the linear motor are coaxially connected with the upper push rod and the lower push rod respectively; the upper sealing plug is arranged at the upper end of the upperpush rod, and a through hole matched with the upper sealing plug is formed in the upper end of the buoyancy compensation water tank; the lower sealing plug is arranged at the lower end of the lower push rod; a through hole matched with the lower sealing plug is formed in the lower end of the buoyancy compensation water tank; when the linear motor drives the upper push rod and the lower push rod tomove upwards, the upper sealing plug extends out of the buoyancy compensation water tank, and meanwhile, the lower sealing plug moves upwards into the buoyancy compensation water tank, the two through holes are opened; when the linear motor drives the upper push rod and the lower push rod to move downwards, the upper sealing plug and the lower sealing plug are matched with the corresponding through holes at the same time, and the buoyancy compensation water tank is sealed.

title: Propeller thrust control method for underwater robot driving
abstract: The invention discloses a thruster thrust control method for underwater robot driving. Comprising the following steps: firstly, constructing an extended state observer and a direct adaptive robust controller of the underwater propeller; then, the real-time state of the underwater propeller is obtained, the expansion state observer carries out expansion state observation according to the real-time state of the underwater propeller and then outputs an external interference compensation value, and the direct self-adaptive robust controller outputs the expected torque of the underwater propeller according to the real-time state of the underwater propeller and the external interference compensation value; and then propeller nonlinear compensation is carried out, actual current is obtained, and the underwater propeller is controlled by using the actual current. According to the method, the thrust of the underwater propeller can be controlled in real time, and the problems of incomplete model hydrodynamic characteristic description, uncompensated dead zone characteristics and inaccurate disturbance estimation under the actual working condition of the underwater propeller are solved, so that the thrust control error of the propeller is reduced, the system stability is ensured, and the control performance is improved.

title: Underwater acoustic navigation systems and methods
abstract: An acoustic underwater navigation system is disclosed. For instance, an underwater receiver determines its position using signals broadcast from an array of acoustic transmitters located near the surface. The position of the array is measured using global positioning system (GPS) technology and the transmitters collectively produce an acoustic signal in which the position and attitude of the array and the GPS time of transmission are encoded. An underwater receiver which is synchronized with the GPS time uses the transmitted position and attitude of the array and the transmission time information to calculate its position.

title: Marine surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle device
abstract: The invention provides a marine surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle device, and relates to the technical field of surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicles. The marine surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle device comprises a machine shell, a fixing block is fixedly connected to one side of the machine shell, a fixing cover is fixedly connected to one side of the fixing block, an arc-shaped plate is fixedly connected to one side of the fixing cover, a mounting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the machine shell, and a protective cover is fixedly connected to one side of the mounting plate. An L-shaped supporting plate is fixedly connected to one side of the mounting plate, a first rotating shaft is rotatably connected to the interior of the L-shaped supporting plate, a first supporting plate is fixedly connected to one end of the first rotating shaft, and a second rotating shaft is rotatably connected to one side of the L-shaped supporting plate. According to the marine surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle device, the observation direction of the surveying and mapping instrument can be adjusted at multiple angles, the observation range is increased, the surveying and mapping efficiency is improved, contact with seabed reefs or seabed is facilitated, the shell is supported, the air bag can reduce energy consumption, the floating speed is increased, loss is reduced, and meanwhile pollution to the marine environment is reduced.

title: Hull cleaning system
abstract: The invention discloses a hull cleaning system which comprises a cleaning robot, a cleaning object recycling device and a control device, and the control device controls the cleaning robot to clean the outer wall of a hull and controls the cleaning object recycling device to recycle cleaning objects. The cleaning robot comprises a robot body and a cleaning mechanism installed on the robot body. The cleaning mechanism at least comprises a shearing mechanism, an ultrasonic cleaning mechanism and a jet flow mechanism from front to back. The cleaning object recovery device comprises a recovery hopper, a negative pressure absorber and the like and a cleaning object treatment device, the recovery hopper is arranged below the cleaning robot, and the negative pressure absorber is at least arranged at the bottom of the recovery hopper and used for conveying cleaning objects into the cleaning object treatment device. Cleaning operation is rapidly completed during berthing of the ship, the requirement that the ship is cleaned in time and sails in time is met, cleaning objects are recycled while cleaning operation is conducted, and cleaning object garbage is prevented from being generated at the berthing place.

title: REMOTE-CONTROLLED ULTRASOUND DEVICE
abstract: The invention relates to a remote-controlled ultrasound device comprising an enclosure envelope (20) containing a tight compartment (32) and a control compartment (34) that are tightly separated by a transverse partition (30). Sensor means (16) are designed so as to move in the tight compartment, submerged in an ultrasonic-wave-propagating medium, and driving means (18) are arranged in the control compartment for triggering the movement of a support rod (36) at the end of which are mounted the sensor means. The support rod extends through the partition in order to connect the driving means and the sensor means, being mounted in a freely rotational manner inside a tube (44) passing through said partition. The invention is especially applicable to remote ultrasound operations in the medical field.
